create_granite4vision_model: create a Granite 4 Vision model using vLLM with SigLIP vision encoder and WindowQFormer projectors
build_deepstack_features: build deepstack vision features by extracting hidden states from SigLIP and projecting via WindowQFormerDownsampler
run_granite4vision_forward: run Granite 4 Vision forward pass with multimodal inputs, injecting deepstack features at target LLM layers
embed_multimodal_inputs: embed multimodal inputs by merging text and vision embeddings with embedding_multiplier scaling
load_granite4vision_weights: load weights into Granite 4 Vision model from HuggingFace checkpoint using AutoWeightsLoader with WeightsMapper
